name: Healthcare Federated Learning Benchmark (Structured Data)
description: A comparative benchmark evaluating engineering and statistical federated learning approaches on structured healthcare data.
reputation: Used by federated learning researchers as a comparative benchmark for FL on healthcare structured data; moderate adoption within the FL community.
notes: Privacy-sensitive, non-iid data and small cohort sizes are common; risk of data leakage/contamination; structured-data benchmark (non-LLM).
